dracula.name: Count Dracula
dracula.role: ancient Transylvanian noble and predatory biological monopoly invading London via real estate and maritime loopholes

jonathan.name: Jonathan Harker
jonathan.role: earnest young English solicitor's clerk who discovers Dracula's true nature and audits the vampire's movements

mina.name: Mina Harker
mina.role: schoolmistress and analytical mastermind whose cross-indexed dossiers, shorthand, and reverse hypnosis dismantle Dracula

helsing.name: Abraham Van Helsing
helsing.role: Dutch polymath doctor and philosopher bridging advanced medicine and arcane folklore to coordinate the hunt

seward.name: Dr. John Seward
seward.role: earnest superintendent of the Purfleet lunatic asylum who records patient Renfield and the vampire hunt on wax cylinders

renfield.name: R. M. Renfield
renfield.role: asylum patient whose zoophagous consumption of flies, spiders, and birds mirrors Dracula's metabolic life-absorption

lucy.name: Lucy Westenra
lucy.role: aristocratic debutante whose somnambulism and gradual vampiric infection expose Victorian somatic vulnerability

quincey.name: Quincey Morris
quincey.role: wealthy adventurous American hunter from Texas who finances the expedition and delivers the fatal heart strike
